verdict.rationale: Snowflake docs describe Snowpipe as enabling near-real-time loading from staged files, but explicitly frame the latency as 'within minutes' rather than seconds, and the evidence pack contains no mention of the low-latency Snowpipe Streaming API (which targets sub-minute/seconds latency) or its documented client SDK. Streams capture change data but are for CDC consumption, not ingestion. Missing for 10: documentation of Snowpipe Streaming API with seconds-level latency claims, client SDK/API reference for streaming ingestion, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of seconds-level queryability.
